name: Realism
intro: Realism is a nineteenth-century movement that painted subjects from everyday life in a naturalistic way. Before it, Western art was led by the academic ideal of history painting. The French novelist Champfleury coined the name in the 1840s, and the painter Gustave Courbet became the movement's best-known example.
homeDescription: How to recognize Realist painting, from Daumier, Courbet, Millet and Manet to Menzel, Repin, Homer and Eakins, in a short illustrated guide.
ldDescription: A short guide to recognizing Realism in France, Europe and the United States, 1834 to 1899, compiled from museum collection records.
